note: Versions through 2.6.0 predate this changelog; their history was not recorded.

added: Invalid values in a shared link or in saved settings are flagged with a notice instead of silently falling back to the defaults.
changed: Complete rewrite in Svelte (previously React). Every displayed statistic is unchanged.

Embedding moved to its own page, /cohend/embed, which accepts the same parameters. Existing iframes that point at /cohend?embed=1 redirect there permanently — nothing breaks, though new embeds should use the new URL. Share links and every displayed statistic are unaffected.
New visual design, as part of the site-wide redesign.
